articles.author: Chinedu Okafor
articles.title: As fear drives 100s to Kenya’s embassy, the government quickly moves to grant temporary amnesty to its undocumented neighbours - Business Insider Africa
articles.description: Amid growing concern among undocumented East Africans in Kenya, the administration led by President William Ruto has decided to grant them temporary amnesty
articles.content:
This decision follows the mass panic on Monday that prompted hundreds of Burundians to run to Kenyas embassy in the countrys capital, Nairobi.
